_comment: Jobs of tools/bake_world_density_art.py. Each item is a source region and every world size the game draws it at (size/sizes: explicit draw rects; fit: LevelProp display boxes, sized like LevelProp._build_artwork). New draw sizes need a line here and a re-bake; WorldTexels.missing lists sizes drawn without a bake.
